summary.result: It is concluded that the CERES-Rice model can be useful to provide efficacious adaptation strategies in Cambodia.
summary.background: We attempted to assess the impact of climate change on rice yields in Cambodia and to investigate adaptation strategies to climate change including more drastically shifting the planting dates and considering more fertilizer application levels.
summary.method: Field experiments conducted at the Cambodian Agricultural Research and Development Institute (CARDI), in 2010, 2011, and 2013 and climate variables from the HadGEM3-RA model were collected for this study.
